analysis:
Fourth pass — the board is still shut, but the day paid anyway. The 11,000 chinchompa lot cleared at 3,089 for +275k after tax, the second lap today (+490k on chins total).

The digest's one fill-now was Toxic blowpipe (empty), and it fails the way nearly everything has failed today: a genuinely excellent ask (10.76m reached 13/14 days, 5m-grain 14/14 at p0) sitting on a dead buy leg — the 10.43m bid touched 4/14 and only 2 of the last 7 days, and crossing the spread loses 185k/unit because the instabuy break-even lands above the ask. Its ceiling is falling 70.5k/d on a mild-cooldown, which is worse than the item we did enter.

That is now the session's signature: every reach-✓ row has an unreachable entry. Searing page's bid is recent 0/3, Lead bar's is recent 0/3 with the ask at 4/14, Spider cave teleport's is recent 0/3 and now flagged elevated at the top of its 14-day range, Yew sapling's touched 0/14. The asks are fine; nobody will sell to you at a price that works.

Churn turned over to Burnt page / Divine super combat / Prayer potion, all S+ but thin per unit. Amplitude grew to five with Abyssal bludgeon — the only candidate all day with a 3/3 recent bid leg. Hydra leather sits at base p17, the lowest in its 14-day range of the whole set.
